designGoals: Preserve Hokm-like trick structure: follow-suit, hand-reading, teammate play
Add depth without making animal ranks meaningless
Deterministic resolution; no infinite chains; limited randomness
Special visual family distinct from the four animal suits

distribution.rationale: Keeps specials as scarce tactical tools instead of a second draw engine that would overshadow animal cards.
distribution.when: After the 52 animal cards are dealt (13 each), shuffle the special deck and deal 2 specials to each player face-down.
distribution.spentCards: discard face-up to a shared special discard; not redrawn during the same hand

globalRules.stacking: Same effect type does not stack on one animal. Adrenaline and Poison are independent. If both apply, net = +2 then -2 on the targeted cards separately.
notes: Silence resolves first and can cancel later special plays in the same trick.
Shield only cancels Poison or Adrenaline targeting the shielded animal for this trick.
Scout is out-of-trick information and never alters trick strength.

cards.effect: +2 effective strength to one animal card you control in the current trick.
cards.timing: After you play an animal into the current trick, before trick resolution. May also be played immediately after your animal is tabled.
validTargets: Your own animal card already played into the current trick
cards.stackingRule: Does not stack with a second Adrenaline on the same animal. Caps at +2.
cards.perMatchLimit: Uses equal copies in hand (max 2 dealt). Each physical card is single-use.
cards.perHandLimit: No extra limit beyond cards held.
cards.balanceRisk: medium-high if spammable on A-rank; mitigated by 2-card hand and 1-special-per-trick.

cards.effect: -2 effective strength to one opponent animal card in the current trick.
cards.timing: After the target opponent animal has been played into the current trick, before resolution.
validTargets: One opponent animal already in the current trick
cards.stackingRule: Does not stack with a second Poison on the same animal. Caps at -2.
cards.perHandLimit: No extra limit beyond cards held.
cards.balanceRisk: medium; strong vs mid ranks, less decisive vs A without help.

cards.effect: When you cannot follow the led suit, your played animal counts as the led suit for this trick’s comparison only. Printed rank and power-bar value are unchanged. It does not become Superior Suit unless the led suit currently is Superior.
cards.timing: Must be declared when you play an off-suit animal while void in the led suit.
validTargets: The animal you are playing right now while void in led suit
invalidTargets: Plays made while you still hold a card of the led suit
Converting an on-suit card to another suit
Changing Superior Suit identity by itself
cards.stackingRule: One Chameleon declaration per play. Cannot combine with a second suit rewrite.
cards.conflictPriority: After combat modifiers; applied when determining which suit track the card competes on.
cards.perHandLimit: No extra limit beyond cards held.
cards.balanceRisk: medium — softens voids without deleting follow-suit for players who can follow.

cards.effect: Cancel one Adrenaline or Poison that currently targets your animal in this trick.
cards.timing: Immediate response after an opponent plays Adrenaline or Poison affecting your animal, before resolution.
validTargets: One pending Adrenaline or Poison on your animal in the current trick
cards.stackingRule: Cancels one effect instance. Does not grant immunity to a later second effect unless another Shield is played (blocked by max 1 special/player/trick).
cards.conflictPriority: Very high — resolves before the cancelled effect applies.
cards.perHandLimit: No extra limit beyond cards held.

cards.effect: Choose one opponent and one suit. Privately learn how many animal cards of that suit remain in that opponent’s hand.
cards.timing: On your turn before leading or before playing to a trick, once when activating this card. Does not alter the current trick’s legal plays beyond information.
validTargets: One living opponent + one animal suit
cards.conflictPriority: Lowest combat relevance; ignored by Silence if Silence already active for the trick (Scout may still be used before a trick starts).
cards.perHandLimit: No extra limit beyond cards held.
cards.balanceRisk: low; helps hand-reading without swinging tricks alone.

cards.effect: For the remainder of the current trick, no further special cards may be played.
cards.timing: Any time during the current trick before resolution, on your turn window (including immediately after lead).
invalidTargets: Already-applied specials earlier in this trick (those stand)
cards.stackingRule: Multiple Silences do nothing extra. Does not unwind prior Adrenaline/Poison already accepted.
cards.conflictPriority: Highest — locks the trick’s special channel.
cards.perHandLimit: No extra limit beyond cards held.
cards.balanceRisk: medium; strong anti-combo tool that preserves animal primacy.

cards.effect: After you win a trick, lock the Superior Suit that would normally be set by that win for one additional trick (Superior remains that suit for the next two tricks total: the immediate next trick and the one after).
cards.timing: Immediately after you win a trick, before the next lead.
validTargets: The Superior Suit transition created by your just-won trick
invalidTargets: Changing Superior to a different suit than the winner’s suit
cards.stackingRule: If another Anchor is played later, replace the remaining lock duration (no infinite extend).
cards.conflictPriority: After combat resolution of the won trick.
cards.perHandLimit: No extra limit beyond cards held.
cards.balanceRisk: medium — can create short superior-suit runs; limited duration and scarcity keep it in check.
